headline: Violent Clashes Reshape Nevish Line as Central Strongholds Shift
war_summary: Since the late-night dispatch, the western theater has erupted with intense volatility along Nevish Line, where fifteen base turnovers in the past two hours have reshuffled the territory into five Warden redoubts, two Colonial outposts, and one demolished no-man's-land. In Marban Hollow, Warden forces reclaimed lost ground, establishing four active garrisons against three Colonial holdings and leaving a single neutral ruin. Linn of Mercy endures relentless friction around Lathair and Outwich Ranch, logging four fresh base transitions that strand three strategic positions in neutral rubble while Colonial troops hold eight. Across Weathered Expanse, where four hubs remain stripped of governance, the grinding meatgrinder produced three further shifts amidst steep bilateral losses. To the south, Callahan's Passage absorbs catastrophic casualty rates—logging nearly three thousand dead in two hours alone—without shifting a single fortification, while Mooring County has quieted under full Warden possession following earlier turbulence at The Wind Hills.
